audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked enemy ability was 'Yasuo Volcanic Rupture' throughout — focus.text, loading, enemyWin, winCon, tldr, the cooldown breakdown, dos and don'ts. Volcanic Rupture is Ornn's own Q; Yasuo does not have it.
audit.why: Yasuo's kit is Way of the Wanderer (P, movement-built shield), Steel Tempest (Q, 4s, knocks up on the cast at 2 stacks, treated as a basic attack), Wind Wall (W, 25/23/21/19/17s, blocks projectiles for 4 seconds), Sweeping Blade (E, near-zero cooldown but not recastable on the same target), Last Breath (R, 70/50/30s, requires an airborne target).
audit.corrected: Replaced the phantom ability with Wind Wall as the tracked cooldown and named Steel Tempest, Sweeping Blade and Last Breath where they decide the trade.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Ornn Level 2 and 2+ items and only Skill at 4-5 and 6, against both the packet chart and the whys prose.
audit.why: whys[1] 'it stays even', whys[3]/[4] Ornn's punish and peak, whys[6] 'give him the late game' — the packet chart matches all of these and the stored chart matched none of them.
audit.corrected: Rows 1,3,4,6 realigned to Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Yasuo in both layers; Level 6 raised to 7/10 and 2+ items dropped to 3/10.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Ornn at 3, Ornn at 6, Ornn on first item, Yasuo once crit items land — consistent with a 53.07% Ornn win rate that decays late.

audit.whatIsWrong: The most punishable cooldown was named as a non-existent ability.
audit.why: Wind Wall at 25s rank 1 for 4 seconds of cover is the real window; Sweeping Blade's cooldown is effectively nil, so it is never the thing to wait out.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns and the dos entries around Wind Wall's real numbers.

edits.after: Brittle him, E-knock him up and out-trade. Ornn wins the 25-second Wind Wall windows.

edits.after: Wind Wall is 25s and lasts 4s — it stops projectiles, never your E knock-up, so wait it out and then engage.

notes: Existing text asserts repeatedly that Bellows Breath is a point-blank exhale that passes through Wind Wall. Ornn's kit file tags his W with the 'projectile' flag (blockable by Wind Wall-class effects), which directly contradicts that claim, and Riot's one-line description ('Ornn advances, breathing fire') settles neither. I did not change or repeat the claim in either direction — it is the single most load-bearing fact in this matchup and needs a ruling. Also note Ornn's R carries a dash flag, so Wind Wall's terrain does not stop it, but the knock-up itself is not a projectile.
